audience: DevOps and on-call engineers who watch uptime and incidents with Better Stack

useCases.title: Check which monitors are down or paused
useCases.text: The AI lists uptime monitors with their status, check frequency and alert settings. You see what is down right now and what is paused.

useCases.title: Review incidents from a date range
useCases.text: The AI lists incidents filtered by date range, monitor, and acknowledged or resolved state. It shows cause, start and resolve times, so you can see how long each lasted.

useCases.title: Find out who is on call
useCases.text: The AI reads the on-call schedules and the users currently on call for escalation. You see who gets paged.

useCases.title: Check heartbeats of cron and background jobs
useCases.text: The AI lists heartbeats with their period, grace time and status. You see which periodic jobs stopped pinging.

useCases.title: Acknowledge or resolve an incident
useCases.text: The AI finds an ongoing incident, then acknowledges it so escalation stops, or resolves it as handled.

useCases.title: Check the state of your status pages
useCases.text: The AI lists public and private status pages with company name, subdomain, aggregate state and published flag.
